2607.05259.title: SalAngaBhava: A Sinhala Market Dataset for Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis
2607.05259.paper_summary: Sentiment analysis has been a primary domain under Natural Language Processing (NLP) from its inception as it plays a vital role in both real-world and research applications. In high-resource languages, this has been extended a step further, and instead of predicting sentiment at the sentence level, models have been developed to detect more fine-grained sentiments at aspect level. However, in order to conduct this fine-grained Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis (ABSA), datasets annotated with aspects and sentiments toward the said aspects is required. Such datasets are lacking for low-resources languages among which, we can count Sinhala, an Indo-Aryan languages used primarily in Sri Lanka. In this work, we introduce, SalAngaBhava, a new Sinhala Aspect-based Sentiment Analysis dataset which contains Sinhala product reviews that are manually labeled with aspect terms and the associated sentiments (positive, negative, neutral). The data was collected from domain-relevant sources such as user-generated reviews and comments, and was annotated following carefully defined guidelines to ensure consistency and quality. The dataset consists of sentences and aspect-sentiment pairs, encompassing a considerable range of aspects from several domains. The analysis confirms that the dataset is well-structured and sufficiently balanced for ABSA research. This dataset can be used as a benchmark and facilitates further studies related to Sinhala natural language processing, and low-resource sentiment analysis tasks.
2607.05259.paper_summary_zh: 情感分析自自然語言處理（NLP）成立以來就是一個主要領域，因為它在現實世界和研究應用中扮演著至關重要的角色。 在高資源語言中，這一領域更進一步，模型不僅僅是在句子層面預測情感，而是開發出能夠在層面上檢測更細緻情感的模型。 然而，為了進行這種細緻的基於層面的情感分析（ABSA），需要帶有層面和對該層面的情感標註的數據集。 對於低資源語言來說，這樣的數據集是缺乏的，其中包括僧伽羅語，這是一種主要在斯里蘭卡使用的印度-雅利安語言。 在這項工作中，我們介紹了SalAngaBhava，一個新的僧伽羅語基於層面的情感分析數據集，其中包含手動標註的僧伽羅語產品評論，這些評論標註了層面術語和相關的情感（正面、負面、中立）。 數據來自於與領域相關的來源，如用戶生成的評論和評論，並按照仔細定義的指南進行標註，以確保一致性和質量。 該數據集由句子和層面-情感對組成，涵蓋了來自幾個領域的相當範圍的層面。 分析確認該數據集結構良好，並且對於ABSA研究來說足夠平衡。 此數據集可以用作基準，並促進與僧伽羅語自然語言處理和低資源情感分析任務相關的進一步研究。
